verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Goal-based multi-step execution, remote triggering via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, and SSH/WSL remote projects. None of it documents delegating tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment. The reported cloud uploads of workspace snapshots are not an execution environment, and the community advice to wrap ZCode in a sandbox is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
